label: The Stage from Redwater
summary: The stagecoach bringing the mine's payroll arrived on time, with no driver, no payroll and one very calm passenger.
title: The Stage from Redwater
description: The stagecoach from Redwater was supposed to bring the payroll for the silver mine. It arrived on time, with no driver, no payroll and one passenger who says she slept through the whole thing.

chapterOutlines.title: An Empty Coach
chapterOutlines.outline: Question the passenger and look over the coach.

chapterOutlines.title: The Silver Hills
chapterOutlines.outline: Follow the trail into the hills.

chapterOutlines.title: Noon at the Bank
chapterOutlines.outline: Settle it, one way or another.

scene.location: Main Street, Dust Creek, at noon, as the stagecoach rolls in
scene.summary: The horses are lathered and the strongbox is gone. A woman in a travel-stained blue dress climbs down and asks where she can get a coffee.

npcs.name: Evangeline Price
npcs.description: Calm, polite and carrying a small pistol in her glove.
goals: Get to the bank before anyone else does

npcs.name: Amos Whitlock
npcs.description: Six weeks in the job and already tired of it. Fair, slow to anger, quick to act.
goals: Find the payroll before the miners riot
